content: It has potential, but I ran into some issues. When trying to set up using email, the button to continue was covered by the bottom menu and back buttons so you can't proceed. Then when connecting accounts, I tried to connect two different accounts with the same institution but different logins (one for me and one is my wife's). What happened was it only kept the latest login so I wasn't able to hook up both at the same time. lastly, the net worth was completely wrong. It's unusable for me for now
Right from the get go, glitches. I tried to enter my birth date during setup, glitch. Not good!
I didn't find this app very intuitive - it was difficult to manually adjust budget, and it did not keep an accurate link of my accounts leaving it days behind.
